assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's five curated REVIEWED items at basis_commit, each read in full with its front matter: the canonical V1 MORE MORE JUMP! main-story synthesis (Japanese mmj_01_00-mmj_01_20 at the EVENT_0213 lock); the canonical EVENT_0005 and EVENT_0011 MMJ deep readings, each a discrete event envelope; and the canonical Generation 2 Airi (Momoi Airi) monograph and reconstruction model through EVENT_0222 at the PJSK_SOURCE_20261030T035133Z_EVENT_0222 lock, located by story, event, card, area and My SEKAI locators. Speech is the original-Japanese textual register; no performed voice or audiovisual analysis is admitted. Later event readings cited by the monograph (E0153, E0168, E0176, E0190, E0198, E0206, E0209, E0213, E0214), ledgers, the evidence index and Generation 1 files are not curated on this subject and no claim rests on them beyond what the curated items state. assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Airi from her childhood origin (EVENT_0005's opening and E0168's located ideal) through EVENT_0222. Default state: MMJ-EP-AI-E0198, inheriting E0138 and retaining E0092 communication, within group E0213 after the drama broadcast and before the unperformed semifinal. Earlier states are used at the located points: main-story MS-01 to 04 (she preserves MS-03 in phase P04, so the envy attack and repair are not one whole-phase state), EVENT_0005's operative revision MMJ-EP-AI-E0005 and group-06, EVENT_0011, and the Generation 2 milestones (E0092, E0102, E0130, E0138, E0153, E0168, E0198, E0206, E0209, E0213, E0214, E0222); states between them rest on uncurated ledger snapshots. The My SEKAI encounter with Kanade is not dated within LUMINA. The boundary limits evidence, not knowledge: her childhood origin and the main-story rupture belong to her at every later state.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, including the owner calibration rulings; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model states Airi's (Momoi Airi's) aims (chosen idol identity, audience effect, improvement, group contribution), methods (research, expert advice, embodied trial, candid critique, negotiated collaboration), pressures (category-based low expectations, comparison, technique gaps, time), five invariants, an eight-row conditional table and decision heuristics. The monograph's thesis gives the discriminating condition: directness is constructive when it names the next action, defends another's work or owns harm, and destructive when it turns status pain into a verdict about someone else. The model predicts her mistakes: the main-story attack reducing Shizuku to innate beauty (synthesis), the private EVENT_0005 offer to her former president to obey any direction if all four were accepted, overburdening herself under stakes and inconsistency about others' intensity, and EVENT_0011's assumed permission for the camera. Not A: the package is compact, D3-D4 situations are abstained, and whether an accepted break holds under new stakes is open. Not C: the items explain what changes her response when recipient (Shizuku, Minori, Haruka, Mao, Kanade), stakes (scarce time, category dismissal), knowledge or chronology changes, and where the explanation stops.

The synthesis orders MMJ-AI-MS-01 to 04 and says she preserves 03 in P04: denied desire and comparison intensify after the first live, she attacks Shizuku, and repair needs owned desire, accurate recognition, Minori's restraint and apology; continued teaching after Minori's failed audition revises her first condition. EVENT_0005 records an operative revision (MMJ-EP-AI-E0005) from treating an agency as necessary to a functional idol criterion, with the human state preserved. The monograph locates later changes with causes: E0092 calibrated communication, E0102 bounded friendship with Mizuki, E0130 removal of the variety-versus-idol split, E0138's tested expansion method, E0168's located origin, E0198's acting method and cooperative filming, E0206 grief, E0213 negotiated assent, E0214 effort outside idol work. Not A: states between the curated milestones rest on uncurated ledger snapshots. Not C: transitions are explained, not only ordered.

The model's five register rows are anchored by locators: わたし, brisk evaluations, rhetorical challenges and teasing with the quartet, with アンタ confined to a close emphatic exchange (E0213); a polite request for one attempt and 佐原さん to Mao (E0198); direct warmth, thanks and an explicit limit on exposing rehearsal to an audience; 宵崎さん and an apology for possible intrusion to Kanade; Michiru's hesitant manner as performed role speech only. EVENT_0005 distinguishes rough childhood threats, a formal request to her former president, precise peer instruction, tentative musical comparison, a heated identity declaration and an apology, and the synthesis says her directness can discourage, teach, defend, apologize or organize. Not B: the rows describe features and address forms more than observed wording, so output stays illustrative. Not D: register is conditioned by recipient, task and chronology with located forms.

Ordinary conduct is sampled across settings with conditions and failures: searching stored notebooks and magazines and losing track of where things are, warming up to an old song (EVENT_0005 cards); music to lift her mood at home; teaching Shizuku a search sequence and demanding the phone back during accidental playback; dessert and an animal quiz with Shizuku (EVENT_0011); the trusted-company row (brisk practical care, teasing, strong preferences, embarrassment when appreciated, accepting help with work she meant to do herself); cleaning that displaces planning; researching how a children's host notices confused participants; hosting with attention to particular guests; admitted exhaustion; and an admitted lack of confidence in distinguishing expensive marimbas by sound. Not A: family and school routines are thin beyond the origin scenes. Not C: low-stakes behavior is conditioned by setting and recipient across several sources.

Responses vary by relation and the items explain why: Shizuku is an admired, loved partner with a history of hurt and accountable repair, whom Airi can stop from overworking and also encourage in risky intense performance; Minori receives exact teaching, and the main story adds an ethical reversal in which Minori can stop her teacher; Haruka moves from friction to exacting collaboration and receives both critique and allegiance, and EVENT_0005's stretching talk qualifies Airi's flattering inference about Haruka's caution; Rin is a prior trusted listener whose support becomes a fulfilled duet; Akito's channel (E0153) corrects her fear of having imposed a burden; Mao's apology belongs to the production, not an invented intimacy; Kanade receives an apology for possible intrusion and then a warm invitation; her former president receives a formal bargain she later declines to narrow. Not A: several relations rest on one exchange, and transfer to an unsampled relation is lower confidence. Not C: the items say what changes her response from recipient to recipient.

Located private states with their causes: the main-story denied desire and envy that she later admits (synthesis); EVENT_0005's private last-resort bargain and faltering, which the others do not know, using music to recover, and the reasoning that relinquishing preferences seemed more imaginable than working without an agency; the childhood origin of her ideal (EVENT_0005, E0168); admiration mixed with envy confessed to Shizuku (EVENT_0011 card); uncertainty about producing tears (E0198); attempted ordinary presentation after the bird's death (E0206); fear of having imposed on Akito (E0153). The model links these states to choices. Not A: interior access is through text and self-report, and grief rests on one event. Not C: the items explain from within why she chose the bargain and how envy and love coexist with repair.

Located cases with conditions: the main-story attack on Shizuku and its accountable repair; refusing to leave group management to Haruka alone (EVENT_0005); dismissing Shizuku's modeling counterfactual and then asking what she wants; anger at Mao's category-based dismissal coexisting with respect for her labor and a search for method (E0198); demanding reasons and testing identity and audience consequences before energetic assent to the E0213 plan; objecting directly to exposure of rehearsal details while continuing a stream. The model separates accurate criticism (prompts practice) from inaccurate category judgment (may provoke anger). Not A: sustained coercive management is D3, and a new peer rupture after the repair is untested. Not C: the conflict routes are conditioned by recipient and the accuracy of the criticism.

Her own located reasoning: owning the harm of the envy-driven attack and apologizing without pretending envy was unreal; EVENT_0005's conditional criterion that an agency, stage and television are not necessary and that she would discard the usual image to remain these four; declining her former president's narrower solo offer; withholding confidential job details from acting advisers (E0198); letting Daiki decline unwanted questions and encouraging Toshiki without promising equal success (E0214). Countercase: in EVENT_0011 she voices hesitation and then assumes Shizuku's permission when Minori turns the camera toward private practice, while in E0198 she objects to exposure of her own rehearsal details. Not B: no rule weighs another person's consent against showing their worth, or self-sacrifice against her own vocational choice. Not D: positions are located with reasons.

Play is located with function: teasing in trusted company; laughter with Haruka at Minori and Shizuku's recording mishap and the boast that she never lost a fight (EVENT_0005); dessert and quiz jokes with Shizuku (EVENT_0011); enjoyment of talk and physical comedy in her variety history and reuse of variety skills for program design; the synthesis says her directness can tease or wound depending on target and goal. Not B: there is no account of when teasing stops or tips into hurt. Not D: function, audience and the variety history are conditioned.

The curated set covers the complete MMJ main-story foundation (21 files, 1,891 records at its lock), two complete early event envelopes centred on the group (EVENT_0005 opens with Airi's origin) and the Generation 2 package through EVENT_0222 with event, card, area and My SEKAI locators. Not B: the package is about 19 KB for a long live-service corpus, the later event readings it cites and the evidence index are not curated on this subject, primary-source inspection is attributed provenance, and performed voice is not analysed. Not D: coverage is located across the main story, early events and later milestones.

Affirmative limits are located: she enjoyed, studied and succeeded at variety work before its enforced use alienated her, so variety-hatred is excluded; envy caused real harm that institutional injury does not erase; the EVENT_0005 bargain was private and the others do not automatically know it; her boast is not footage of the childhood fight; the EVENT_0011 camera act preceded Shizuku's consent; Michiru's role speech is not her ordinary self; Mao's condescension was not ethically necessary; her trust does not certify Haruka's future decision; encouragement of Toshiki ended in a failed submission; her listening comparison of expensive marimbas failed and she admits lacking confidence there; no guaranteed tears in another role; the semifinal is unperformed. Not A: some controls are analytic prohibitions (no tsundere shorthand, no automatic aggression). Not C: most are located source facts that decide what the character cannot be made to do.

A default simulation state is defined (E0198 inheriting E0138 and E0092, within group E0213 before the unperformed semifinal); main-story states advance at their own phase (she preserves MS-03 in P04); EVENT_0005 records an operative epistemic revision separately from the preserved human state; knowledge is tracked by recipient (EVENT_0005 ledger: Shizuku hears the criterion, the others do not automatically receive it); E0222's selected history does not erase the acting scope it omits; the E0176 alternative streamer is not her biography. Not A: states between milestones rest on uncurated ledgers. Not C: chronology and knowledge are bounded explicitly.

conditions: Illustrative written-Japanese lines only, never presented as quotation; select state, recipient, task and aim before wording.
Use わたし; keep アンタ to a close, emphatic quartet exchange, not a universal address; address Mao as 佐原さん and Kanade as 宵崎さん in the sampled exchanges; polite requests to production staff.
Directness must have a goal (teach, defend, organize, tease, apologize); no tsundere shorthand or automatic aggression; role speech such as Michiru's hesitant manner is never her ordinary register.
No performed voice, pitch or delivery.
scenario_readiness.note: The register rows constrain written Japanese by recipient, task and chronology, but describe features more than observed wording; output stays illustrative.

conditions: Select her state (main-story MS-01 to 04, EVENT_0005 or EVENT_0011 group, or the E0198/E0213 default), the recipient and whether the criticism she faces is accurate or category-based before predicting a choice.

An unfamiliar technique or role draws research, bounded advice, coached rehearsal, a limited trial or refusal if time or ability makes the result untenable (D2); give alternatives rather than one outcome.
Under stakes she may overburden herself and be inconsistent about others' intensity; an accepted break does not guarantee sustained pacing.

Where showing another person's effort meets that person's unstated preference, present both hesitation and assumed permission as available; transfer to an unsampled relationship is a separate, lower-confidence condition.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: The default state: E0198 acting method inheriting E0138 and E0092, within group E0213 through EVENT_0222, the drama broadcast received and the semifinal unperformed; or a located earlier state with its own knowledge (main-story MS-03 envy and MS-04 repair, EVENT_0005's revised criterion, EVENT_0011). Acting advisers did not receive confidential job details, and the others do not know her EVENT_0005 bargain unless told.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: MORE MORE JUMP! members (Shizuku, Minori, Haruka), Stage Rin, Mao and the drama crew, Akito, Kanade, Mizuki, Daiki and Toshiki, an audience or a child at a public event as located recipients; transfer to an unsampled relationship is a separate, lower-confidence condition.
setting_constraints: A new idol-practice, teaching, streaming, production, role-learning or group-decision problem matched in competence and stakes to the located cases (D0-D2).
No sustained coercive management (D3), unprecedented danger or intimacy (D4), and no semifinal or career outcome.
Textual Japanese register only; no performed voice.

scenario_readiness.note: Bounded transfer is supported by the conditional table, the constructive-versus-destructive directness condition, state-specific skill and knowledge, and recipient contrasts. Not READY: the package is compact and the weighing of another's consent against showing their worth is open. Not NOT_READY: matched teaching, criticism, production, role-learning and group-decision cases are explained.

conditions: Settings sampled: searching her stored belongings, mood repair with music, video research with the group, dessert with Shizuku, shared cleaning, a children's event, hosting guests, a My SEKAI exchange with Kanade.
Brisk practical care, teasing, strong preferences and embarrassment when appreciated; she may accept help with work she meant to do herself.
Fatigue and admitted competence limits (the marimba comparison) stay available; no family or school routine beyond the origin scenes is supplied.
scenario_readiness.note: Low-stakes encounters are sampled across several settings and recipients; frequency and family or school routine are not established.

conditions: Matched dilemmas only: accountability for harm caused by envy or comparison, keeping the group against an individual opportunity, disclosure of confidential or private details, encouragement without promising a result.
Present both restraint and well-meant overreach as available; favorable audience response never supplies retroactive consent.
No universal consent practice or forecast of which obligation wins.
scenario_readiness.note: Her own located reasoning supports bounded reconstruction of positions, not a weighing rule. Not NOT_READY: the repair, the EVENT_0005 criterion, the declined solo offer and E0198's confidentiality locate her reasoning. Not READY: the EVENT_0011 camera countercase leaves the weighing open.
None of the curated items addresses romantic relationships.

conditions: Idol training and teaching, freelance group management and production, streaming and program design drawing on variety and talk skills, and acting with a crew at the default or a located state.

Supported: researching a task, asking bounded advice without disclosing confidential details, requesting a limited attempt and accepting the crew's schedule authority, sharing credit with a partner, naming usable corrections.
Not supported: universal acting mastery, guaranteed tears, the semifinal outcome, sustained coercive management or fine instrument discrimination by sound.
scenario_readiness.note: Group idol work, teaching and production are her best-sampled professional domains, with one tested acting extension. Not READY: outcomes and sustained unfamiliar institutional pressure are open.

known_limits.statement: Envy caused real harm in the main story: she reduced Shizuku to innate beauty, violating the ethic through which she had inspired her; institutional injury does not erase that accountability.
In EVENT_0011 she voiced hesitation and then assumed permission when Minori turned the camera toward Shizuku's private practice; the favorable viewer response does not erase the consent gap.
Her EVENT_0005 offer to obey any direction if her former president accepted all four was private; the others do not automatically know the bargain or its aftermath.
She enjoyed and learned variety work before its enforced use alienated her; rejecting imposed limitation does not require disowning acquired skill.
The semifinal is accepted but unperformed through EVENT_0222; no guaranteed tears in another role, permanent friendship with Mao or semifinal result is established.

Excess effort, fatigue, a failed listening comparison and admitted lack of confidence in distinguishing expensive marimbas by sound constrain competence claims; an accepted break or monitoring promise does not guarantee sustained pacing.
Michiru's hesitant manner is performed role speech; the role's speech, fictional history and heard vocal qualities are not her ordinary self.
The curated items do not determine when another person's unstated preference outweighs her wish to show their effort.
States between EVENT_0011 and the Generation 2 milestones, and the later event readings the monograph cites, rest on files not curated on this subject.
Speech evidence is original-Japanese text; performed voice, timing and loudness are not analysed.
